scope: provider-specific Amazon S3 Object Lock durable-retention preparation only

aws_read_only_identity_inspection.reason: The task required stopping before claiming executable account or region bindings when AWS authentication was unavailable. No CLI installation, credential discovery, or broader environment change was attempted.

region_decision.required_resolution: A separate read-only audit must bind the caller account, partition, configured/allowed regions, data-residency policy, bucket availability and CloudTrail coverage; a human must then approve one exact region.

bucket_decision.design: new dedicated general-purpose evidence bucket only
bucket_decision.reason_existing_bucket_not_selected: Object Lock is irreversible at bucket level and Versioning cannot be suspended afterward; no general-purpose or unverified bucket may be modified merely because it exists.
controls: all four Block Public Access controls enabled
no unrelated contents or lifecycle rules

encryption_decision.reason: The retained evidence is public historical baseball source data. SSE-S3 supplies service-managed encryption at rest while avoiding a separate KMS key whose disablement, deletion or policy loss could strand unreadable bytes under an unshortenable Compliance lock.

sse_s3.confidentiality: encrypted at rest with S3-managed keys and private bucket access
sse_s3.integrity: client SHA-256, S3 checksum response and full read-back remain authoritative; ETag is metadata only
sse_s3.permissions: S3 role permissions only with explicit AES256 request enforcement
sse_s3.auditability: S3/CloudTrail object events record encryption response

sse_kms.availability_risk: disabled, deleted or inaccessible key can make Compliance-locked bytes unreadable
sse_kms.permissions: adds kms:Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey and DescribeKey
sse_kms.auditability: adds KMS events and key-policy audit surface
sse_kms.long_term_dependency: key and policy must outlive retention plus recovery margin

roles: MlbStatcastEvidenceRetentionInfrastructureV1: one exact bucket configuration only; no IAM/KMS/object deletion
MlbStatcastEvidenceRetentionWriterV1: exact prefix inspection, exactly two PutObject/PutObjectRetention targets and exact-version read-back; no delete or bucket administration
MlbStatcastEvidenceRetentionVerifierV1: bucket-control, exact-version, retention and audit reads only
iam_and_bucket_policy.bucket_policy: deny insecure transport, public access, deletion and wrong encryption/retention; grant PutObject only to the bound writer role for the exact two object ARNs; no third-key grant

audit_design.required: An approved CloudTrail trail or event data store must already capture management events plus AWS::S3::Object data events for the exact bucket/prefix before upload.
audit_design.if_absent: stop for separate exact audit-configuration authorization; do not upload

actions_not_performed: no S3 bucket or object creation
no Versioning or Object Lock change
no IAM, KMS, CloudTrail, encryption, policy, public-access or retention change
no evidence download, upload, relocation or deletion
no workflow dispatch or Statcast request
no source-contract activation, confirmation capture or scientific promotion
